exact: adenylyl cyclase inhibiting metabotropic glutamate receptor activity
related: adenylate cyclase inhibiting metabotropic glutamate receptor activity

definition: Combining with glutamate and transmitting the signal across the membrane by activating the alpha-subunit of an associated heterotrimeric G-protein complex to inhibit downstream adenylate cyclase activity.
label: adenylate cyclase inhibiting G protein-coupled glutamate receptor activity
